title: RPSC Exam Calendar 2026
vacancyDetails: Includes RAS Combined Competitive Exam Pre/Mains and other RPSC recruitments scheduled through 2026-27
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Open Forthcoming Examinations / Proposed Exam Date
3. Download latest press notes and calendar PDFs
4. Note RAS Pre, Mains and other exam dates
5. Check press notes for any rescheduling
shortDescription: RPSC Exam Calendar 2026 – RAS Prelims listed around 6 Dec 2026; Mains May 2027. Check rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in for full schedule.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) publishes forthcoming examination schedules and press notes for the year 2026.

Key highlights from recent notices include RAS (State & Subordinate Services Combined Competitive Exam) Prelims around 6 December 2026 and Mains tentatively in May 2027, along with Lecturer, APO and other departmental exams.

Always verify on rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in as dates may be revised for administrative reasons.
